name: Metaphysics Engine
alternateName: 无状态术数与排盘算法能力层
description: Metaphysics Engine is an open-source (MIT), self-hostable, stateless calculation engine for Chinese metaphysics and Western astrology — BaZi (Four Pillars), Zi Wei Dou Shu, Liu Yao (King Fang), Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, Ba Zhai feng shui, almanac day-selection, name grids, Tarot, I Ching, Zodiac/Ascendant, and Synastry — exposed as a documented OpenAPI 3.0.3 HTTP API (31 paths), a programmatic --json CLI (./bazi), and a 14-tool stdio MCP server.
applicationSubCategory: Stateless calculation engine, HTTP API, Agent CLI, and MCP Server
featureList: BaZi (Four Pillars) calculation with weighted hidden stems, Ten Gods, Da Yun luck cycles, and True Solar Time (88 cities + lat/lon)
Zi Wei Dou Shu charting with Five-Element Bureau, 12 palaces, 14 major stars, 20 B-grade stars, trine-and-opposition (三方四正), Si Hua, and flowYear
Liu Yao (King Fang) hexagram assembly with 8-palace derivation, six relatives/gods, moving-line interactions, and Zhou Yi text
Da Liu Ren divination with heaven/earth plates, stem lodging, four courses, and all nine three-transmission gates
Qi Men Dun Jia charting with chai-bu bureau, rotating plate, palace relational readings, gate oppression (门迫), and tomb/punishment flags
Ba Zhai feng shui life trigram and house trigram matching
Three-layer Chinese Almanac (day, 13 sub-hour slots, and annual directions computed by formula)
Tarot draws (deterministic with seed via FNV-1a + mulberry32), I Ching divination (Wikisource Zhou Yi canonical text), Zodiac/Ascendant, and Synastry
Optional AI interpretation via mock, OpenAI, or Anthropic providers with concurrency gate and stream idle timeout
OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract (31 endpoints) served at /api-docs with snapshot verification in CI
Programmatic ./bazi CLI with --json output, deterministic exit codes (0/1/2/3/4/5/7), and tool schema export (Anthropic/OpenAI/MCP)
Read-only stdio MCP server (./bazi mcp) exposing 14 capability tools
Machine-readable school rulings registry (backend/constants/rulings.js) returned in every response school field
Stateless architecture with optional Redis cache, Pino JSON logging, /live, /health, /api/ready, and Prometheus /metrics
otherRequirements: No database or user account store is included or required
Redis (REDIS_URL) is strictly optional for cross-instance BaZi cache sharing
OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are optional; deterministic calculations run with zero API keys and AI interpretation falls back to mock
DOCS_PASSWORD is required when starting with NODE_ENV=production
